lessons: Do not bulk-merge feature/search-core into main when bundle composition diverges.
Use AnyTour Design System 2.0 only; Design System 1.0 is obsolete.
Do not change Metrika goals, external lead transport, Tourvisor contracts, pricing semantics or the logo without explicit approval.
Local filtering is safe only when the loaded payload is complete enough for the selected facet.
Lead UI async acceptance must be scoped to both tourId and searchId, not tourId alone.
Responsive selected-tour structure should not depend on optional decoration classes when the canonical DOM structure is stable.
Post-success handoff must consume canonical DS2 footer destinations; removed legacy footer selectors are not a valid runtime dependency.
Room-details async acceptance cannot rely on tourId alone; the selected room identity must also still match before a delayed response decorates the current host.
Flight async acceptance is already generation-scoped and current-tour-scoped; preserve those guards when touching flight lifecycle.
Tour-load async acceptance must be invalidated by search reset, not only by another tour selection; targeted integration fixtures must preserve production bundle listener order.

A lead submission snapshots the selected flight before network completion, so the visible flight controls must not remain mutable while that request is pending; recovery should unlock only after a current lead error.
